core_obligations: Repeat the iteration of the permutation case in the matching language, using the matching versions of the representative, covering and structure lemmas as substitutes (source lines 752-756).
Use the permutation covering bound where the reduction of the matching case to it is available, and conclude the same recursive bound on the number of cosets (source lines 756-758).

proof_roadmap.step: Translate the covering and structure steps to matchings.

difficulty_reason: Counted unit is the author's labelled lemma at source lines 742-750, the matching counterpart of the permutation covering bound: a maximal 2-intersecting family of perfect matchings whose characteristic function has degree at most two is contained in the union of at most T cosets of its own certificate size, with the same recursion for T. The proof (source lines 751-759) redoes the iteration in the matching language, replacing each of the three tools of the permutation case by its matching version and invoking the permutation bound where the reduction is available. The statement records the covering and the value of T, and neither the substitution of the tools nor the reduction.
